limitations: Pilot sample only; not a complete cluster census.
The paired artifact contains token-level records but not the full source sentence/utterance.
No candidate IPA, syllabification, allophone, or phonological analysis is supplied.
Do not score boundary-sensitive or morphologically ambiguous items without original utterance context.
reviewer_instructions: Independently transcribe each item in broad phonemic IPA first.
If useful, add a separate narrow phonetic transcription and state the allophonic detail represented.
State syllable boundaries and vowel length only under a declared convention and supported evidence.
Classify the distinction as phonemic, predictable allophony, transcription convention, lexical variation, or unresolved.
Cite primary sources or describe phonetic evidence, method, and confidence.
Do not infer a productive Kozak Kim rule from this pilot packet.

required_before_scoring: Restore exact source utterance for every source_row_id from the licensed corpus artifact.
Verify per-item redistribution and reviewer-sharing rights.
Assign separate blind copies and freeze first-pass submissions before reconciliation.
acceptance_gate.promotion_rule: No production change until independent review, source adjudication, positive/negative/boundary/interaction controls, and exact-head paired verification are complete.

review_question: For these forms, what is the appropriate segmental and syllabic analysis of the high front rounded vowel/glide sequence, and is the difference phonemic or representational?
